front.title: Canonical Payload Binding: A Signed Statement Construction Profile

abstract.t: Independently written systems that anchor records to a SCITT Transparency Service repeatedly re-derive the same construction: a canonical form of structured content, a content-addressed identifier derived from that form, a receipt placed in the unprotected header of the Signed Statement, and a typed reference mechanism that lets one record cite another by digest across profile boundaries. This document defines that construction as a reusable profile — the Canonical Payload Binding — so that each payload class declares its canonicalization algorithm and exclusion set once, obtains an interoperable derived identifier, and inherits statement-to-receipt binding and typed digest reference semantics without restating the mechanics in every profile. IANA registries govern both the canonicalization algorithms and the artifact types that may appear in typed references; entries are immutable.
